description: RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) golden vector. input_json is parsed as JSON text; canonical is the exact output (UTF-8); every host canonicalizer must reproduce canonical_utf8_hex and sha256. Covers HTML-sensitive characters and U+2028 (never escaped), keys whose UTF-16 order (U+D83D… before U+E000) differs from UTF-8 order, and ECMAScript number serialisation (1e21 → 1e+21, 1e-7, 0.1, -0 → 0).
